name: Uagi-Saba 2
detailed_description:
Uagi-Saba 2 is a complex creature care/breeding sim inspired by some of my favorite artificial life sims from when I was a child.

Watch your creatures hatch from eggs and raise them to adults. Creatures can see, hear, smell and think for themselves and are all born with their own unique genes/personalities. Guide them through beautiful hand drawn environments using speech and positive/negative reinforcement. They can learn from experiences, form relationships with other creatures and breed. Breed strong family lines through selective breeding and find rare mutations after multiple generations. Laugh and interact with your creature and cry when they reach the end...

Features/Mechanics

  • Explore
    A variety of biomes to explore. Snowy drifts. crystal caves, forgotten mines, magma vents and alien ruins.

  • Protect
    You are the guardian, guide your creatures safely through life. Lead them to water and bring them food. Show them the way to safety and help them avoid danger.

  • Variety
    Every creature is very different from the last. Each can be born with a variety of different body parts and genes. Body, head, ears, horns ,eyes, arms, legs, fur, scales. Color genes can also influence the individual color of body parts, including eyes. The possibilities are endless with hundreds of combinations.

  • Speak
    Learn your creatures native language by looking through old books and scrolls. When fluent you can use commands to influence creature decisions.

  • Clean Up And Customize



    Remove junk from sanctuary and use the scrap collected to decorate and customize your surroundings.

  • Memories

    Your creatures will form memories based on objects or locations it spends the most time around. It will even remember other creatures, form relationships and eventually mate.

  • Learn
    Your creatures will learn over time through positive and negative reinforcement and can pass on things they have learned to their offspring. They will learn from experience but also from watching you and other creatures!

  • Evolve
    Creatures may evolve differently based on the biomes they spend most time in. Raise your creatures in a cold biome they may evolve fur and form resistance to cold. Raise your creature in a warm arid biome and they may evolve scales and form resistance to heat.

  • Food And Drink
    Your creatures will find a variety of food and drink items in the world, some good and some bad. Water containers, fruits, vegetables, nuts, berries, mushrooms and poisonous plants.

  • Breeding
    An in depth genetics system, creatures can breed and pass on their genetics. This includes body chemical genes, resistances, body part genes, skin/eye color and many more gene types. Only breed your favorite genes and create the ultimate super creature.

Minimum:

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
